name: Kami no Ne
description: A quiet, editorial store theme for small washi paper and stationery shops that sell handmade paper, thread-bound notebooks, brush pens, inkstones, letter sets, seals and gift sets online: paper white and kozo surfaces, sumi ink and a deep ai indigo with one pale persimmon dot, large still-life photography on an asymmetric twelve-column grid with vertical section marks and staggered product shelves, Cormorant titles with indigo italics over Zen Kaku Gothic New text, mounted-print picture frames and hairline rules that fold to one calm column on a phone, plus a makers page, Saturday workshops with dates, prices and a booking form, a monthly letter, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

fonts.role: display: titles, italics, prices, big numbers and the wordmark
body text, labels, navigation, forms and buttons
